how.title: How CareCircle Works
how.description: CareCircle is a collective support platform that brings communities together to give what they can to help, celebrate, or support someone in need.

steps.oneDescription: Set up an occasion, add specific wishlist items, or choose a flexible mutual-aid milestone in Naira.
steps.oneDetail: Flexible templates for care funds and community support.
steps.twoDescription: Share one beautiful link on WhatsApp, social media, or email. Anyone can chip in.
steps.twoDetail: A single link invites your community to give what they can through card, transfer, or USSD.
steps.threeDescription: Funds clear to verified fulfillment or the recipient, alongside a scrapbook of everyone’s warm blessings.
steps.threeDetail: Funds reach verified needs with a keepsake of community love and gratitude.

how.ctaBody: Create a private or public circle now — no initial payment needed.
